name: 95338 · Mariposa, CA
findings: ZIP 95338 (Mariposa) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95338 (Mariposa) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
46% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95338 (Mariposa) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).
